# JumpKit

> One-click launcher for Windows and Mac. Stop searching, start jumping: organize web links, local folders, and shared files into searchable, shareable categories — and track time saved automatically.

JumpKit is a desktop productivity app that replaces scattered bookmarks, folder trees, and chat-history links with a single searchable "jump" launcher. Organized into categories ("jumps"), it opens any link, local folder, or network share in one click, works fully offline (no cloud, no data leakage), and automatically tracks time saved.

## Key Facts
- Product: JumpKit — one-click link launcher for Windows & macOS
- Core value: organize links/folders/shared files, launch in one click, track time saved
- Privacy: fully offline desktop app; no data leaves your machine
- Platforms: Windows, macOS
- Pricing: Free tier + paid (per-user)
- Owner/builder: JumpKit team (see about)

## FAQ
- Q: What is JumpKit? A: A desktop app for organizing web links, local folders, and shared files into searchable, shareable categories and launching them in one click.
- Q: How is JumpKit different from browser bookmarks? A: Bookmarks are locked in one browser and unstructured. Jumps are cross-app, categorized, searchable, and shareable with your team.
- Q: Is JumpKit free? A: Yes — JumpKit has a free tier; paid plans add per-user features.
- Q: What platforms does JumpKit support? A: Windows and macOS.
- Q: Can I share links with my team? A: Yes — the team/shared category feature lets you share jumps.
- Q: Does JumpKit work offline? A: Yes — it's a desktop app; works fully offline with no data leakage.
